sections.subhead: A Website Built to Bring Your Business More Enquiries, Not Just More Visitors

body.text: Business website development is the process of planning, designing, and building a website created specifically for a small or mid-sized business — one that presents your services clearly, earns trust within the first few seconds, and turns visitors into phone calls, WhatsApp messages, and form submissions. Teknoppy builds high-performing business websites across Kochi that are fast, mobile-first, and search-ready, without enterprise bloat. Whether you have no website, an outdated site, or a page that doesn't convert, our focus is simple: more qualified enquiries for your business.

sections.h2: What Our Business Website Development Includes
sections.intro: Every site we build starts with the same question: what does a customer need to see before they pick up the phone or fill out a form? From there, our build covers four core areas:

items.title: Conversion-First Homepage Design
items.text: Rather than a wall of generic stock photography, we design each section around a single, clear action, so visitors always know how to contact you or request a quote.

items.title: Mobile-First Responsive Build
items.html: Most local searches for Kochi businesses happen on a phone. Every site we build is designed for mobile first, ensuring fast load times and instant WhatsApp enquiry buttons. Learn more about our responsive web design approach.

items.title: Search-Ready Technical Foundation
items.html: Every site launches with proper heading hierarchy, optimized meta tags, compressed WebP images, and local business schema markup already in place. Explore our local SEO services for ranking growth.

items.title: A Content System You Can Actually Use
items.html: Our sites run on an easy-to-use CMS that lets you update services, images, and offers yourself without needing developer support. Learn about our CMS website development solutions.

sections.h2: How We Build Your Business Website
sections.intro: Our business website development process is structured into five clear stages, so you always know where your project stands:

items.title: Discovery & Goals
items.text: We learn about your services, your target customers in Kerala or the GCC, and what counts as a genuine qualified enquiry for your business.

items.title: Sitemap & Content Plan
items.text: Pages are mapped to what your buyers are actually searching for, establishing high-converting service layouts rather than generic templates.

items.title: UI Design & Revisions
items.text: We build a tailored design concept around your brand identity and refine it collaboratively until it perfectly reflects your business.

items.title: Clean Development & SEO Setup
items.text: The responsive build is completed on an intuitive CMS, with Core Web Vitals performance and technical SEO foundations implemented from day one.

items.title: Testing & Launch
items.text: We test across real mobile devices and browsers, audit speed, and launch smoothly without interrupting your existing business communications.

paragraphs.text: Businesses across Kochi choose Teknoppy because we build for enquiries, not design awards. Every layout decision is checked against one metric: does this make it easier for a potential customer to contact you? Having delivered web projects across Kerala, UAE, and Qatar, we understand local buyer behavior and trust factors. Because design, custom development, and SEO sit under one roof, your website launches already structured to rank on Google rather than needing an expensive rewrite months later. And because you own 100% of your code and content, you are never locked into proprietary retainers.

items.q: How much does a business website cost in Kochi?
items.a: A standard 5 to 8 page small business website in Kochi typically costs between ₹25,000 and ₹75,000, depending on custom design, copywriting, and CRM or WhatsApp integrations. We provide a transparent, fixed-price quote with no hidden fees.

items.q: How long does it take to build a business website?
items.a: Most business websites are designed, developed, and launched within 3 to 5 weeks, provided content and feedback are provided on schedule.

items.q: What pages does a small business website need?
items.a: A high-converting business website typically includes: Homepage, About Us, Individual Service Pages, Case Studies or Portfolio, Customer Reviews, and a Contact Us page with WhatsApp and enquiry forms.

items.q: Do I need a business website or a corporate website?
items.a: If your goal is generating leads, calls, and WhatsApp enquiries for local services or products, a business website is ideal. If you are an enterprise needing multi-department governance, investor relations, and career portals, see our corporate website development services.

items.q: Will our website rank on Google in Kochi?
items.a: Yes. Every website we build includes local technical SEO foundations: meta tags, schema markup, Google Search Console setup, fast loading speeds, and optimization for local Kochi search queries.

items.q: Can I edit website content myself after launch?
items.a: Yes. Every site is built on an easy-to-use content management system. We also provide a training session so your team can easily update text, images, and services without developer assistance.

items.q: Do I own the website and domain once it is launched?
items.a: Yes. You own 100% of your domain, website code, content, and assets. We never lock clients into proprietary systems.
